{
 "query": "Premium Butcher Shop E-commerce",
 "filters": {
  "industry": "food-beverage"
 },
 "count": 4,
 "tip": "Thumbnails inline. Top rows carry the fold autopsy; get_screen(slug) for the others. Hero complete inside 1280x800; 80-160px between sections; copy in a centered padded column.",
 "images": "https://0nme3pk5am3urwa9.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/captures/<slug>/hero.1440.webp (also full.1440, thumb.384, mobile.384; get_screen returns exact URLs)",
 "results": [
  {
   "slug": "grassrootscoop-com",
   "title": "Buy Grass Fed Meat Online | Healthy, Pastured Meats Delivered - Grass Roots Farmers' Cooperative",
   "northstar": "Soft, earthy tones and generous spacing evoke a tranquil, spacious, and thoughtfully curated feeling.",
   "autopsy": "FOLD: Top olive banner with white text. Nav: logo left, center links (SHOP dropdowns, RECIPES), icons right. Hero: white card (left ~30%) with \"Feed Your Family Food You Can Trust\" (title case, 4 lines, serif), body copy below, olive rectangular CTA \"SHOP CUSTOMER FAVORITES\". Full-bleed pastoral photo of cattle in sunlit field (right ~70%, extends behind card edge). Headline and card float over left; visual dominates right. Balance: 1/3 text, 2/3 image.\n\nTYPE: Display: Lora serif, light weight, wide, elegant. Body: Source Sans Pro/Noto Sans sans. Scale jump ~3:1. Title case headlines, sentence case body. No tracking quirks.\n\nCOLOR: Background #d7d3a1 (banner), white card; text #4e5823 (dark olive); accent #878139 (olive buttons, links). CTA button filled olive with white text.\n\nSIGNATURE: White text card overlapping full-bleed pastoral photography - editorial magazine layout on agricultural e-commerce, with sun-flare photo bleeding to all edges while card maintains crisp margin.",
   "palette": ["#878139", "#d7d3a1", "#4e5823", "#8a8f61", "#bcc4b7"],
   "fonts": ["Lora", "Source Sans Pro"],
   "mode": "light",
   "macro": "split-studio",
   "axes": "mid / roman-serif / chromatic-other (~105) / Lora",
   "tags": "minimalism, editorial, swiss · food-beverage, ecommerce · warm, calm, soft · hero-fullbleed, logo-cloud, hero-with-cta"
  },
  {
   "slug": "mooala-com",
   "title": "Mooala | Organic Plant Based Milk for the Whole Family - Mooala Brands",
   "northstar": "Warm, softly textured ochre - clean, friendly sans serif - expansive, gentle negative space.",
   "autopsy": "FOLD: Nav top-left (logo + koala icon, four text links, icons right). Headline: \"Organic Plantmilks\" - sentence case, left-aligned, 2 lines, large serif, overlaps hero visual. Supporting copy: 3 lines small sans below headline. CTA: white rectangle button, \"Shop now\", sits under copy. Hero: product photo of almond milk bottle + glass + scattered almonds/honey dipper, fills ~65% right and lower viewport, warm beige gradient background. Headline intrudes left third; visual dominates right two-thirds, creating asymmetric balance.\n\nTYPE: Display: serif (Libre Baskerville), regular weight, wide, elegant with slight bracketed contrast. Body: sans (DM Sans), light. Scale jump ~4:1. Display sentence case; body all lowercase start.\n\nCOLOR: Background warm beige (#e8c190 to #ccb9ab gradient). Text dark brown (#64380f). Accent: white (#fff) on CTA button; dark brown (#a46a21) on nav hover potential.\n\nSIGNATURE: Headline serif text directly overlapping photographic product scene - type bleeds into image without container, creating integrated depth layer.",
   "palette": ["#a46a21", "#e8c190", "#64380f", "#ac8464", "#ccb9ab"],
   "fonts": ["Libre Baskerville", "DM Sans"],
   "mode": "light",
   "macro": "bento-grid",
   "axes": "mid / roman-serif / chromatic-other (~67) / Libre Baskerville",
   "tags": "minimalism, editorial, swiss · food-beverage, ecommerce · calm, warm, soft · hero-fullbleed, logo-cloud, hero-with-cta"
  },
  {
   "slug": "ritual-com",
   "title": "Ritual",
   "northstar": "Warm, airy minimalism: soft yellow hues, clean sans-serif, generous white space breathes clarity.",
   "autopsy": "FOLD: Top navy promo bar with \"Save 20%... Shop All\" and X close. Nav: \"Menu\" left, \"Ritual\" centered, \"Our Standards\" + search + account + cart right. Hero: left 60% is cropped photo of smiling woman in yellow tank against blue sky; right 40% is off-white panel with headline \"The future of health is clear\" (3 lines, sentence case, \"clear\" italicized), body \"Traceable science and sourcing - for living life or creating it.\", two navy pill buttons \"Shop Daily Health\" and \"Shop Pregnancy\". Pause icon overlays photo bottom-right. Below fold: \"Shop Bestsellers\" left, \"Shop All\" right, product strip beginning.\n\nTYPE: Display: CircularXX, sans, medium weight, slightly condensed, calm geometry. Body: Arial or similar sans, lighter weight. Scale jump: ~3:1 display-to-body. Signature: italic \"clear\" in headline.\n\nCOLOR: Background: off-white #faeda4-tinted panel right, photo left. Text: deep navy #142c6c. Accent: navy buttons, orange #d45404 in palette hint (not visible hero). Warm blue-gray #93a6c6 in sky.\n\nSIGNATURE: Italic word \"clear\" as sole typographic flourish in otherwise restrained headline, creating soft emphasis against geometric sans.",
   "palette": ["#d45404", "#faeda4", "#142c6c", "#a7654c", "#93a8c6"],
   "fonts": ["CircularXX", "Arial"],
   "mode": "light",
   "macro": "marquee-hero",
   "axes": "light / geometric-sans / warm / CircularXX",
   "tags": "minimalism, editorial, swiss · health, food-beverage, ecommerce · calm, soft, warm · hero-fullbleed, logo-cloud, hero-with-cta"
  },
  {
   "slug": "graza-co",
   "title": "GRAZA | High Quality Olive Oil",
   "northstar": "Warm ochre and soft gray, clean sans-serif, open spaciousness, a quiet, natural elegance.",
   "palette": ["#843c28", "#e0a899", "#5c2c14", "#937659", "#cecb9a"],
   "fonts": ["ITC Garamond Condensed", "Apercu", "GT Alpina Typewriter"],
   "mode": "light",
   "macro": "split-studio",
   "axes": "mid / display-condensed-bold / warm / ITC Garamond Condensed",
   "tags": "minimalism, editorial, swiss · food-beverage, ecommerce · calm, warm, soft · hero-fullbleed, logo-cloud, hero-with-cta"
  }
 ]
}
